evidence.title: The AI Powered SuperApp for Work | Motion

name: Motion
summary: AI productivity platform that auto-plans your day, schedules tasks and meetings, and manages projects, docs and notes.
description: AI work management suite for individuals and teams: projects, tasks, calendar, meetings, docs, notes, reports and workflows. Motion prioritizes tasks by deadlines, dependencies and duration, plans the calendar around them and re-plans as things change, builds entire projects from a description, and its notetaker produces summaries, action items and follow-up emails. Apps for iOS, Android and desktop; integrations include Google Calendar, Gmail, Outlook, Slack, Zoom, Teams, HubSpot, Salesforce and Zapier. Paid plans from $19/seat/month with a free trial.
